reproduction.final_timing_script:
require 'json'
root=File.dirname(__FILE__)
runs=[]
%w[point range index aggregate sort].each do |kind|
  count=kind=='point' ? 1000000 : 50000
  expected=nil
  %w[before final final before].each_with_index do |stage,i|
    path="#{root}/paired-#{kind}-#{i}-#{stage}.log"
    abort "benchmark #{stage} #{kind}" unless system("#{root}/#{stage}",count.to_s,kind,out:path,err:[:child,:out])
    lines=File.readlines(path)
    results=lines.grep(/^RESULT /)
    abort 'row or metadata mismatch' if expected && results!=expected
    expected=results
    times=lines.grep(/^TIME /).map{|line| _,k,round,ns,n=line.split;{kind:k,round:round.to_i,ns:ns.to_i,count:n.to_i}}
    runs<<{stage:stage,kind:kind,results:results,times:times}
  end
end
summary={}
%w[point range index aggregate sort].each do |kind|
  grouped=%w[before final].map{|stage|runs.select{|r|r[:stage]==stage && r[:kind]==kind}.map{|r|r[:times].map{|t|t[:ns].to_f/t[:count]}.sort}}
  med=grouped.map{|g|a=g.flatten.sort;(a[4]+a[5])/2}
  per_run=grouped.map{|g|g.map{|a|a[2]}}
  summary[kind]={before_ns:med[0],after_ns:med[1],change_percent:(med[1]/med[0]-1)*100,per_run_medians:per_run,values:grouped}
end
puts JSON.pretty_generate({runs:runs,summary:summary})
reproduction.fixture_script:
root=File.dirname(__FILE__)
topics=["table/index","explain_easy","explain_complex","util/ranger","index_join","index_merge","executor/aggregate","session/clustered_index","executor/prepared","expression/charset_and_collation","common_collation","collation_pointget","subquery","planner/core/join_reorder_through_projection","executor/update","executor/delete","expression/constant_fold","expression/builtin","expression/cast","expression/plan_cache"]
stage,binary=ARGV
normalize=->(text){text.gsub(/in\s+\d+ms/,'in TIME').gsub(/finished in [0-9.]+s/,'finished in TIME')}
topics.each do |topic|
  path="#{root}/#{stage}-#{topic.tr('/', '_')}.log"
  next if stage=='before' && File.exist?(path)
  abort topic unless system({'INTEGRATION_TOPIC'=>topic,'INTEGRATION_SHOW_DIVERGENCES'=>'1'},binary,'--ignored','--nocapture','replay_one_topic_from_env','--test-threads=12',out:path,err:[:child,:out])
  if stage=='after'
    before=normalize.call(File.read(path.sub('/after-','/before-')))
    if topic=='expression/builtin'
      old="--- [expression/builtin] select interval(1,0,1,2,1/0);\n  tidb warnings: <none>\n  rust warnings: Warning\t1365\tDivision by 0\n"
      abort 'missing prior interval divergence' unless before.include?(old)
      before=before.sub(old,'').sub('1278 matched    13 diverged','1279 matched    12 diverged').sub('{"Rows": 802, "SideEffect": 476}','{"Rows": 803, "SideEffect": 476}')
    end
    abort "different #{topic}" unless normalize.call(File.read(path))==before
    puts(topic=='expression/builtin' ? "IMPROVED interval warning; other builtin output identical" : "IDENTICAL #{topic}")
  end
end
